publication_evidence.statement_summary: Farside says ETF data is updated in real time and updates typically occur in the evening and night US time.
publication_evidence.limitation: This describes typical behavior; it is not a guaranteed publication deadline and does not establish an exact observed_at timestamp.

freshness_rule: Use the latest completed US ETF trading session. Allow a 12-hour post-close publication grace period spanning midnight US time. After that, require a complete reconciled Farside row no more than one actual scheduled trading session behind. Missing/incomplete rows are never treated as zero.
source_priority_rule: Farside is the priority research source; SoSoValue is comparison-only; TFTC is supplemental. Never average sources or automatically substitute a different source.
acceptance_boundary: Research/test contract only. This policy does not approve production ingestion, prove provider finality, or grant storage/retention rights.
